title: SyncCycleFailed.v1
description: Emitted when the sync cycle throws or returns a failed result. Error messages are sanitised at the emission site (no stack traces, no embedded values).

cycleId.description: Matches the cycleId on the corresponding SyncCycleStarted event.
cycleId.markdownDescription: Matches the cycleId on the corresponding SyncCycleStarted event.

errorMessage.description: Sanitised error message. Stack traces and file paths are stripped before emission.
errorMessage.markdownDescription: Sanitised error message. Stack traces and file paths are stripped before emission.

durationMs.description: Wall-clock duration before the failure, in milliseconds.
durationMs.markdownDescription: Wall-clock duration before the failure, in milliseconds.
